verdict.rationale: Zero documents its own natural-language features: the founder says users can "chat with their inbox" and draft replies, and MCP.md lists asking questions about mailbox content and threads and composing with AI assistance. Evidence that natural-language commands can drive actions like archiving, labeling or deleting comes only through MCP tools invoked by an external agent. That MCP surface is thinly documented and authenticated by copying a browser session cookie. Missing for 10: documented in-product natural-language commands that perform mailbox actions, depth or examples of the chat interface, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
